name: An autoscaler that cannot see its metrics (a control plane that depends on what it controls)
description: The API servers autoscale. Before each decision the autoscaler asks the "metrics service" for the load (the edge is a "control plane" edge). The metrics service runs in the same cluster on the same resources: at 20 s traffic triples and the metrics service is swamped too (100 times slower, every query takes longer than its 1 s timeout). The autoscaler cannot see the numbers and does nothing (see the API's "Blind checks" and the timeline), so the 4 original servers carry three times the traffic. Like Roblox in 2021 (service discovery and monitoring both ran on the failing Consul) and AWS us-east-1 in 2021 (internal network congestion blinded monitoring and the control plane together). Try this: delete the API → metrics service edge (the autoscaler reads the cloud platform's own metrics, outside the cluster it watches) and run again: it adds servers from 25 s.
